methods.name: Stage-Progression

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Verse is a Series B climate and energy technology company that has raised $83.3M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M), supplemented by a broader universe of 8 private peers and 1 public comparable.

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $158M based on the $83.3M raised proxy. Peer-median analysis references the 3-company comparable set, which has a median valuation of $1.0B and a range from $700M to $3.0B. The peer-median approach produces an $1.0B implied valuation, reflecting the stage and sector positioning of the reference companies.

The two methods produce a wide range reflecting genuine uncertainty about Verse's relative standing within its peer cohort. The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $135M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $579M. The dispersion between stage-progression and peer-median results underscores sensitivity to peer selection and stage-mapping assumptions. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the Series C peer set as a forward anchor and the extent to which Verse's technology differentiation warrants positioning above or below the peer median.
